consumer.use: Decide whether the passed R3 v3 Outcome-Bound admission semantics are feasible on the first three prospective natural Bureau operator-intake identity births without delaying productive work.

decision_target.question: Can exactly three first-in-order post-activation candidate_identity_birth slots be prospectively admitted under C/S/B/E/T/Q with zero binding failures, zero authority violations, zero backfill and median handling <= 10 minutes?

intervention.name: R3-v3 prospective three-slot admission
intervention.description: The experiment is registered as active testing before A while execution_status remains designed. After reviewed merge, set A to one explicit Bureau activation-marker event id; then consume the first three fully provable later candidate identity births in numeric event-id order and attempt C/S/B/E/T/Q binding before productive mutation without delaying work.

control_condition.description: The last three fully provable canonical candidate identity births with event_id < A are frozen after A only as negative eligibility sentinels: each must remain excluded because it predates A. They are not pilot cases and their outcomes are not compared for efficacy.

treatment_condition.description: Exactly the first three fully provable canonical candidate identity births with identity_first_event.event_id > A, subject to the inherited R3 v3 hard birth-proof and self-interference rules.

measurement.method: Before A, keep this experiment active as testing while execution_status remains designed and results/decision.yml remains not_executed. A may be written only after exact-head reviewed merge, complete Bureau birth-projection proof, and a frozen slot_capture_contract for one already-existing durable provider surface. That surface must provider-own an absent -> begun -> terminal per-slot state machine with deterministic caller slot_id, atomic idempotent begin bound to canonical birth identity, provider-owned capture-session continuity/liveness, provider-owned begin-to-terminal elapsed timing, atomic immutable terminalization of one complete admission payload, exact crash/restart readback, same-id/same-payload convergence, hard same-id/different-payload conflict detection, provider SHA-256 evidence identity, and no operational authority. For a valid live session the controller may finalize exactly one admission payload. A successful frozen admission must terminalize before productive mutation; failure states whose defining trigger is productive mutation or outcome/result knowledge terminalize immediately after that trigger is authoritatively established and can never be reclassified as frozen. If provider-owned liveness proves that a begun session is irrecoverably lost, only the provider may atomically terminalize that same slot to indeterminate with binding_failure_increment=1 and reason capture_session_lost; a replacement never reconstructs a successful capture. If no existing surface proves the contract, A MUST NOT be written. The cohort is exactly the first three fully provable post-A candidate_identity_birth events. Before handling any later ordinal, reconstruct every earlier birth and read provider state; absent, begun, unresolved or otherwise nonterminal earlier state blocks the later ordinal. Any ambiguous begin/finalize outcome is resolved only by provider readback. No client-side claim/intent/failure-record/re-serialization state machine exists.
measurement.success: 3/3 fixed canonical slots, binding_failure_count == 0, zero material review disagreements, zero authority violations, zero replacement/backfill, all three provider states durably terminal with valid immutable evidence, median provider elapsed handling <= 600 seconds, and at least two definitive non-D0 cases.
measurement.falsification: Any binding failure, provider state/session/payload conflict, unresolved or nonterminal earlier provider state, experiment interference, ambiguous causation, authority violation, replacement/backfill, noncanonical ordering, post-result binding, or material exact-head review disagreement rejects the revision.

cost_metric.method: For each consumed slot, provider begin establishes handling start and provider terminalization establishes handling finish; provider-computed elapsed seconds are metric authority. The interval includes C/S/B/E/T/Q analysis and terminal-payload construction, excludes pre-slot Bureau birth discovery/proof and post-terminalization review, and is never optimized by delaying productive work. A begun slot that cannot reach a valid terminal state is a binding failure or unresolved-provider-state REJECT rather than a censored timing observation. PASS requires the three-slot median <= 600 seconds.

comparison.unit: three fixed pre-A negative eligibility sentinels versus three post-A pilot slots
comparability_constraints: activation boundary is the Bureau marker event id A, not a retrospectively selected timestamp
only identity_first_event.event_id ascending determines slot order
no replacement or backfill after any slot outcome
R3 v3 sampling semantics remain unchanged
no Full Outcome Case is collected
confounders: the first three births may contain too few informative non-D0 cases
observer independence may be hard to prove for some slots
three cases establish only tiny-sample feasibility, not product efficacy
